description: Source code for PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) PDU translation and processing in a 3GPP 5G NR context, including functions to fill DCI parameters and CORESET configurations, and a conversion function to translate FAPI PDU to internal PHY representation.

methods.name: fill_dci
methods.description: Populates the DCI parameters of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data and precoding matrix repository.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Configures the CORESET parameters of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data.

methods.name: convert_pdcch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts a FAPI PDCCH PDU into the internal PHY PDU format, filling in coreset and DCI information.
